Description

The classrooms at Ashmole Academy are available to hire for a wide range of educational, professional, and community activities. Conveniently located in London, these well-equipped learning spaces are ideal for tutoring, training courses, workshops, meetings, revision sessions, language classes, and after-school clubs.

Designed to provide a comfortable and productive environment, the classrooms are suitable for both small and larger groups and can accommodate regular bookings as well as one-off sessions.

Whether you're delivering educational programmes, hosting professional training, or running a community group, Ashmole Academy's classrooms offer a practical, affordable, and accessible venue in North London.
